description: This Java class 'AndroidKeyStore' provides methods to interact with the Android KeyStore, including checking support for signature and cipher algorithms, signing messages, and encrypting data using private keys. It interfaces with native code via annotations and manages cryptographic operations.

classes.name: AndroidKeyStore
classes.description: Provides cryptographic operations and checks support for algorithms using Android KeyStore, interfacing with native code.

methods.name: getPrivateKeyClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the provided PrivateKey object.

methods.name: privateKeySupportsSignature
methods.description: Checks if the given PrivateKey supports a specified signature algorithm.

methods.name: privateKeySupportsCipher
methods.description: Checks if the given PrivateKey supports a specified cipher algorithm.

methods.name: signWithPrivateKey
methods.description: Signs a message with the specified PrivateKey and algorithm, returning the signature bytes.

methods.name: encryptWithPrivateKey
methods.description: Encrypts data with the specified PrivateKey and algorithm, returning ciphertext bytes.
